note: Starter food library for Gym Log. Values are from USDA FoodData Central: Foundation Foods (Dec 2025), SR Legacy (Apr 2018) and FNDDS 2021-2023. Every row records its source fdcId in `provenance`. Fiber is dietary fiber, contained within carbs rather than additional to them; where the chosen record carried no fiber value one was taken from the closest match in another dataset, noted as `fiberFrom`. Per-count rows were converted from per-100g using `gramsPerCount`.
